name: Assayer's Tools (Thí Kim Tam Khí)

bonuses.rule: a foe your art hits while it carries a buff is stamped for 6 s; the next buff it gains burns off at once, and you gain a ward worth 5 % of your health.

story: Crucible, stamp and robe of the house's founder, made in its first decade. They are the house; whoever holds all three is its head, whatever the house's book says.

name: Thumb on the Scale (Thủ Chỉ Áp Cân)

bonuses.rule: the House Weight's tipped roll comes twice a fight; after each tipped roll you see the next art that foe will use.

story: The founder's House Weight and the counterweight its keeper cast for it in 1160. Tưởng Ngọc Cân keeps both on the house's side of the square, and never lets them be weighed apart.
